name: Example: Calculating a State Vector
problem:
![](/home/jake/Developer/Course_Academy/reference/mathacademy/question-capture-workers/linear/14059948/assets/165917feacd28344502759fc6e03f96c5b54d9530701916b746fc489374a6d0b.png) 

Consider a Markov chain with the stochastic matrix $P$ and the initial state vector $\mathbf{x}_0$ given above. Calculate the state vector $\mathbf{x}_2.$
worked_solution:
To find the state vector $\mathbf{x}_2,$ we apply two steps of the Markov chain:

$$
\mathbf{x_1}=P\mathbf{x}_0, \qquad \mathbf{x}_2=P\mathbf{x}_1
$$

After the first step, we have

$$
\begin{aligned}{x}_{1} & =P{x}_{0} \\  & =[\begin{aligned}0.5 & 0.1 \\ 0.5 & 0.9\end{aligned}][\begin{aligned}0.2 \\ 0.8\end{aligned}] \\  & =[\begin{aligned}0.18 \\ 0.82\end{aligned}].\end{aligned}
$$

Finally, after the second step, we obtain 

$$
\begin{aligned}{x}_{2} & =P{x}_{1} \\  & =[\begin{aligned}0.5 & 0.1 \\ 0.5 & 0.9\end{aligned}][\begin{aligned}0.18 \\ 0.82\end{aligned}] \\  & =[\begin{aligned}0.172 \\ 0.828\end{aligned}].\end{aligned}
$$
